name: RegentFX Fast Boot
author: omp
description: Conditional boot-stall fix for RegentFX. Requires RegentFXFastBoot to load BEFORE RegentFX. The game's modding screen cannot reorder mods, so set the order with a load-order editor: Load Order Manager (Steam Workshop 3747605109) adds a Load Order button to the modding screen - move RegentFXFastBoot above RegentFX, Apply, restart. Keep exactly ONE RegentFXFastBoot install: a local copy plus a workshop copy adds a second row later in mod_list, and sorting keys priorities by id with last index winning, so that later row overrides the enabled one and forces late order every launch. The mod reports both outcomes with a one-shot popup on the main menu: if the launch could not be accelerated (RegentFX loaded first) it explains the steps above and offers 'do not show again'; if it was accelerated it says so and requires no action. Neither popup writes your game settings - the only file the mod writes is its own notice state - and neither reorders your mods. In the correct order it skips RegentFX's synchronous scene preload (only when RegentFX's own PreloadEffects setting is on) and re-warms the same scene cache one path at a time through the engine's own asynchronous loading surface.
